M1: global greedy pairing in ascending distance; ties broken by (min pair_id, max pair_id); each PATIENT used at most once
S4: randomised greedy nearest-neighbour (seeded random VISITING ORDER): draw k uses seed 1042+k; rows are visited in that order; each row whose patient is unused is paired with its nearest in-caliper partner from an unused patient (ties by pair_id); patient-once
caliper_primary: p75 of each row's nearest cross-patient same-stratum distance
distance: root-mean-square z-difference over jointly observed features
label: RETROSPECTIVE MOLECULAR ASSOCIATION - NOT PREDICTIVE VALIDATION
primary_family: ordinal (multiclass universe; pairs whose Vt+1 classes differ)
rna_usage_in_matching: RNA availability defines the universe only. No RNA value and no RNA age is used for distance, strata, caliper, candidate ordering or pair selection.
standardisation: z-score per feature on the matching universe after winsorisation
universe: RNA-available rows (days_since_rna_sample notna; used ONLY to define row membership) with non-missing current_line_number; binary additionally eligible_for_binary
